repos_data.description: Agent-native flight & hotel search and booking — MCP server, CLI, and Python/JS SDKs. Every airline in the world, major booking sites and OTAs, with per-flight reliability history.
Calendar MCP server with atomic booking, conflict prevention, deterministic RRULE expansion, and TOON token compression for AI agents
Booking.com MCP server by HasData: search stays and read full property details, as JSON.

Field operations over MCP — constraint-based scheduling on a deterministic solver, manageable from Claude or ChatGPT. Match crews to jobs by location, skills & availability; booking, work orders, dispatch, CRM, fleet (HVAC, plumbing, electrical, home services).
FOR SALE $8K — Production AI travel booking engine. 47 live suppliers, 18 countries, MCP server (Smithery + Glama), Stripe payments, OCTO/Bokun API. See /for-sale page.
MCP server for Meet.bot. AI agents check real calendar availability and book meetings on Google/Microsoft calendars. Pay per meeting booked, not per seat.
MCP server for the CallChatSyn API: answer small-business customer questions from their FAQs, list open appointment times and book them. Free for the first 1,000 businesses.
